synthesis.executive_summary: 今日OCR与文档解析研究进展显著，在索引增强、推理评估、任务验证、成本优化、跨粒度训练、上下文压缩、领域适应、查询优化和语义分块等方面均有突破。文档理解正从单纯的OCR向多模态推理与可靠性验证转变，同时成本效益和性能优化成为工程落地关注点。
synthesis.trend_summary: 趋势一：索引与推理向训练无关或轻量级优化方向发展，如MIDR将多模态推理迁移至索引阶段。趋势二：基准评估注重细粒度与可靠性，新型指标区分答案正确性与推理过程合规性。趋势三：数据筛选与训练策略优化受重视，难度感知和条件训练提升性能。趋势四：成本效益分析成为研究标配，小模型和上下文压缩方案降低成本。趋势五：领域适应通过小样本微调实现突破，如考古手写文档。
common_innovations: 利用多模态或多粒度融合优化索引与训练，如MIDR的索引增强和跨粒度条件训练。
在评估中引入元认知或验证环节，如OCR-MetaReasoning和VeriOCRBench。
部署成本与效率被纳入模型设计考量，如MoE架构和质量调整经济学。
通过动态或模块化策略适应任务特性，如语义分块和可学习查询。
小样本微调实现领域专业化，如考古记录和临床文档信息提取。
future_directions: 将任务验证和元推理能力整合至OCR文档解析模型，以减少盲从和提升可靠性。
探索结合文本与连续记忆token的混合压缩策略，优化高压缩率下的性能，并扩展多模态支持。
设计自适应联合训练方案，动态平衡跨粒度任务权重，避免性能权衡。
开发自动配置语义分块策略模块，实现任务自适应分块以提升IE性能。
利用难度感知与外部反馈迭代细调数据筛选与查询生成流程，强化低资源场景下的适应能力。
在中英文口语与书面文字混合场景中验证解码器优化策略，以减少词汇先验偏差。
将幻觉检测框架Enoki原型轻量化后嵌入OCR信息抽取流水线，提供细粒度溯源验证。
推进领域知识注入、多模态联合提示调优技术，以增强对罕见组合与上下文关系的判断与抽取。
engineering_takeaways: 利用如MIDR索引增强等方法可降低视觉模型在线推理延迟约2倍、存储约9倍，适合高吞吐文档服务。
采用LoRA微调通用OCR模型可大幅提升特定场景任务准确率（如考古字段恢复误差从32%降至1.5%）。
设计查询问题时合理利用LoQ+FeedQ方法可在四个临床基准上平均提升F1约18.6点，但大于更换更大模型的增益。
利用小规模MoE模型与质量-成本校准可逐步替代人工基础流程，预期成本降低约80%（具体视场景而定）。
条件训练有利于跨粒度信息抽取，需按需求对任务标注粒度、输入格式进行配置，并保持语料覆盖多样化。
Deploying challenge检测框架可明显提高模型文本生成的可靠性，尤其适用于低容错率行业（如临床、法律）的部署。

watchlist.title: VeriOCRBench: Beyond Blind Compliance: Benchmarking Task Verification in OCR Reasoning
watchlist.watch_reason: 该任务验证基准对提高OCR系统可靠性与防盲从问题有实际应用价值，建议观察后续模型在该基准上的表现。

watchlist.title: LatentPress: Context Compression Beyond Text and Vision
watchlist.watch_reason: 该压缩方法可实现跨文档长期记忆的有损轻量化快速读写，可能成为多模态RAG的基础组件，值得追踪其扩展集。

watchlist.watch_reason: 训练无关的索引增强与混合检索设计，可能在常见OCR场景里被直接复用或迭代，对比评估基准后续表现。

watchlist.watch_reason: 强调通过查询设计本身来改善信息抽取性能，其公布的LoQ/FeedQ和12K训练数据可能比模型更换更经济，适合持续技术验证。

papers.title: MIDR: Enrichment-Augmented Indexing for Multimodal Document Retrieval
papers.summary: Retrieval over visually rich documents has a representation problem: important content often lives in tables, charts, figures, and layout relations that plain OCR linearizes, corrupts, or omits. ColPali-family visual retrievers address this with patch-level multi-vector indexes and late-interaction scoring, keeping image-derived retrieval on the query-time serving path. We introduce MIDR (Multimodal Indexing for Document Retrieval), a training-free framework for enrichment-augmented indexing that shifts multimodal reasoning to index time. During ingestion, a multimodal LLM converts rendered pages into verified textual fields that are indexed with BM25F and optionally fused with dense retrieval, enabling text-centric serving over multimodally grounded evidence. On ViDoRe V3, MIDR Hybrid achieves 0.6219 average nDCG across five English domains, a 23.0% relative gain over BM25, remaining competitive with ColQwen2.5. On two French-document domains, enrichment bridges English queries and French page text, lifting BM25 from 0.1532 to 0.5448 nDCG and outperforming ColQwen2.5. Across all seven domains, MIDR leads ColQwen2.5 on four while using approximately 9x smaller index memory and approximately 2x lower query latency. These results establish index-time multimodal reasoning as a compelling accuracy-deployment alternative to serving-time visual late interaction.
papers.zh_summary: MIDR 提出了一种无需训练的多模态文档检索索引框架。该方法在索引阶段利用多模态大语言模型将文档页面转换为经过验证的文本字段，并采用 BM25F 进行索引，可选与稠密检索融合。在 ViDoRe V3 基准上，MIDR Hybrid 平均 nDCG 达 0.6219，相对 BM25 提升 23%，与 ColQwen2.5 相当，在法语文档场景中效果显著。相比 ColQwen2.5，MIDR 在索引内存和查询延迟上分别降低约 9 倍和 2 倍，展示了在索引时进行多模态推理作为服务时视觉晚交互替代方案的潜力。
papers.novelty: 将多模态推理从查询时转移到索引时，提出无需训练的增强索引框架，兼顾文本为中心的服务和基于多模态的证据。
innovation_points: 提出训练无关的增强索引框架，利用多模态 LLM 在索引时生成验证过的文本字段
将 BM25F 与稠密检索融合的混合索引策略
在英语和法语文档域上均表现出强竞争力，显著降低索引存储和查询延迟
papers.limitations: 仅验证于特定检索基准（ViDoRe V3），未覆盖所有文档类型；依赖多模态 LLM 在索引时的生成质量，可能不适用于低资源语言。
improvement_directions: 扩展至更多语言和文档类型，验证框架的通用性
探索自适应索引策略，根据文档类型动态选择索引字段
研究如何进一步降低多模态 LLM 索引时的计算成本
papers.engineering_value: 为需要大规模文档检索的应用提供高精度、低延迟的部署方案，尤其适合多语言场景。
papers.why_relevant: 针对视觉丰富文档检索的表征问题，提供索引时推理的新思路，对当前 OCR 后的文档理解具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding
papers.summary: Text-rich image understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to organize OCR (Optical Character Recognition)-grounded evidence across words, layout, fields, charts, and visual correspondences. Existing evaluations often conflate extraction with reasoning and rarely test whether models follow the required reasoning direction: applying visible rules, abstracting hidden regularities, or recovering missing premises. We introduce OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that treats deduction, induction, and abduction as distinct directions and separates final-answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance. The benchmark contains 1,500 verified samples in a balanced \(3\times5\) taxonomy crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories, along with reference reasoning steps, automatic answer scoring, the Meta-Reasoning Macro Score (MRMS), and the Reasoning Process Compliance Score (RPCS). Experiments with representative closed-source and open-source MLLMs show that OCR-grounded meta-reasoning remains far from saturated: models struggle with visible-rule application and layout-sensitive inference, while process-compliant rationales can accompany incorrect final answers under exact-match evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/gengxuli/OCR-MetaReasoning.
papers.zh_summary: OCR-MetaReasoning 是一个受控的单图像基准，专门测试多模态大模型在文本丰富图像中的元推理能力，将演绎、归纳和溯因作为独立推理方向，并将最终答案正确性与推理过程合规性分开评估。基准包含 1500 个样本，采用 3x5 平衡分类法，并提供了参考推理步骤、自动评分指标 MRMS 和 RPCS。实验表明，OCR 元推理远未饱和，模型在应用可见规则和布局敏感推理上存在困难，且过程合规的推理可能伴随错误答案。
papers.novelty: 首次将元推理（演绎、归纳、溯因）系统性地引入 OCR 文本丰富图像理解评估，并区分答案正确性与推理过程合规性。
innovation_points: 构建包含 1500 个样本的受控基准，采用 3x5 分类法
提出 Meta-Reasoning Macro Score 和 Reasoning Process Compliance Score 评估指标
提供参考推理步骤，支持自动评分
papers.limitations: 实验仅覆盖已有 MLLM，可能在特定领域表现不佳；基准为单图像受控场景，可能未完全反映真实复杂文档。
improvement_directions: 扩展至多图像、多页文档场景，增加现实性
改进指标以更好地捕捉推理过程的质量
探索如何提升模型在规则应用和布局感知推理上的能力
papers.engineering_value: 为 OCR 文档理解模型的鲁棒性评估提供基准，有助于开发更可靠的推理模型。
papers.why_relevant: 指出当前 MLLM 在 OCR 推理中过程与结果分离的现象，为文档 AI 的评测标准提供重要参考。

papers.title: Beyond Blind Compliance: Benchmarking Task Verification in OCR Reasoning
papers.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on OCR-centric document understanding and text-rich visual reasoning benchmarks. Yet existing evaluations largely assume that every task is valid and answerable. In real-world OCR scenarios, this assumption often fails: questions may rely on illegible text, occluded evidence, nonexistent visual targets, contradictory premises, or missing variables. We study this reliability gap as OCR-grounded Task Verification: before answering, a model should determine whether the Image Premise (IP), Textual Premise (TP), and Question (Q) jointly define an executable task. We introduce VeriOCRBench, a 1,800-sample human-verified benchmark built from source images drawn from 8 OCR-related datasets and spanning 8 real-world image domains, with controlled, image-grounded diagnostic tasks. It contains 1,600 trap-injected invalid tasks across 8 trap types and four verification dimensions---Visual, Contextual, Factual, and Logical---plus 200 trap-free controls for measuring over-refusal. Built with a Visual Atomic Fact (VAF)-anchored pipeline and full human auditing, VeriOCRBench enables decoupled evaluation of task verification, root-cause diagnosis, and over-refusal. Evaluating 15 leading MLLMs reveals persistent blind compliance, diagnosis failures, and prompt-induced over-refusal, exposing a critical reliability gap in current OCR reasoning systems. The code is available at: https://github.com/zy001122/Beyond-Blind-Compliance.
papers.zh_summary: VeriOCRBench 是一个 1800 样本的人工验证基准，专注于评估多模态大模型在 OCR 推理中的任务验证能力，即在回答前判断图像前提、文本前提和问题是否共同构成可执行任务。基准包含 1600 个陷阱注入的无效任务（覆盖 8 种陷阱类型、4 个验证维度）和 200 个无陷阱控制样本，用于评估任务验证、根因诊断和过度拒绝。实验显示 15 个主流 MLLM 存在盲从、诊断失败以及提示引发的过度拒绝，暴露了可靠性缺口。
papers.novelty: 首次系统化评估 OCR 推理中的任务验证能力，发掘模型盲从问题，提供细粒度的诊断基准。
innovation_points: 构建包含陷阱注入的基准，覆盖多种任务不可执行场景
提出基于视觉原子事实的流水线并辅以人工审核
解耦评估任务验证、根因诊断和过度拒绝
papers.limitations: 基准仅涉及英文文档，可能未覆盖多语言场景；过度拒绝控制仅 200 个，相对较少。
improvement_directions: 扩展至多语言文档，提高基准多样性
增加更多真实场景中常见的不可执行任务类型
设计更全面的指标以衡量根因诊断的准确性
papers.engineering_value: 为 OCR 文档问答系统提供可靠性评估工具，有助于减少盲目回答，提升实际部署可信度。
papers.why_relevant: 揭示了模型在无效任务上的盲从风险，对关键领域（如法务、医疗）中的 OCR 应用至关重要。

papers.title: Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics
papers.summary: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation. We present a deployed document-understanding system built on a Mixture-of-Experts VLM (35B total, 3B active), fine-tuned on in-house production data mixed with open-domain documents curated by a Difficulty-Aware pipeline for layout diversity, fact-extractability, and cross-model consistency. Fitting on a single H100 and serving heterogeneous workflows via prompting, the model leads all deployable (non-reasoning) baselines up to an order of magnitude larger. A quality-adjusted cost analysis, with confirmation and correction costs calibrated from production telemetry, shows it reduces expected costs by over 80% against the human baseline and by more than 50% against the best competing open-source model, while larger baselines remain economically unviable.
papers.zh_summary: 该论文介绍了一个专为文档理解部署的视觉语言模型系统，采用 Mixture-of-Experts 架构（总参 35B，激活 3B），通过难度感知的流水线对内部生产数据和开放文档数据进行筛选并微调。系统在单个 H100 上运行，通过提示适配不同工作流，其性能优于其他可部署的基线模型。质量调整成本分析显示，相比人工基线和最佳开源模型，预期成本分别降低 80% 和 50% 以上。
papers.novelty: 提出难度感知的数据筛选流水线，并量化质量调整后的部署经济性，展示小规模 MoE VLM 在成本效益上的优势。
innovation_points: 采用 MoE 架构（总参 35B，激活 3B），适合资源受限环境
开发难度感知的数据筛选流水线，融合布局多样性、事实可提取性和跨模型一致性
基于生产遥测数据校准质量调整成本分析，量化经济效益
papers.limitations: 系统基于私有数据，可能不适用于通用文档；成本模型依赖于特定业务场景，一定程度上限制了结论的泛化性。
improvement_directions: 探索更有效的数据难度指标，增强跨领域泛化能力
研究如何进一步压缩模型但保持质量，以降低部署成本
扩展至更多工作流，验证系统的普适性
papers.engineering_value: 为受监管行业提供低成本的文档理解解决方案，具有显著的经济效益。
papers.why_relevant: 展示了如何通过数据筛选和模型设计在成本和质量间取得平衡，对于商业化 OCR 系统具有直接启示。

papers.title: Joint Training Is Not Enough: Conditioned Cross-Granularity Training for Multimodal Document Understanding
papers.summary: The Mutual Reinforcement Effect (MRE) asks whether a fine, span-level and a coarse, document-level task help each other when one model handles both. We test it in multimodal document understanding on three corpora, two of receipts and one of scanned business forms, comparing single-task, joint and conditioned training, which puts one granularity's gold output in the other's prompt during training only. We build Doc-MRE, an annotation layer pairing gold field extraction (point) with four document-level facets (line), from a three-judge LLM committee under a pre-registration, validated by blind re-annotation. One predicate, fixed in advance: at a shared recipe, a regime reinforces if it beats the matched single-task model on both granularities. Mixed joint training, the arrangement prior MRE work assumes, reinforces on no corpus at the main scale: it is below both single-task models on CORD and trades one granularity for the other on the two others, as single-task tuning does. Conditioned training reinforces on two of the three, CORD (+0.5 point, +4.8 line) and the forms corpus (+7.2 point, +11.0 line), resolvably on the coarse side and directionally on the fine one, and trades on WildReceipt; at that recipe no alternative measurably beats it on either side anywhere. Two byte-identical-prompt controls separate content from format: shuffled conditioning destroys the coarse-side skill but costs the fine side far less, and a neutral-content control reproduces the whole fine-side gain on WildReceipt, which is therefore prompt structure but buys nothing resolvable on the other two. On the forms corpus conditioning buys collapse avoidance: mixed training and the neutral control both assign the majority semantic label to all 50 test documents; only conditioning recovers the gold distribution. Probes find the information decodable under every regime with no resolvable increase under conditioning.
papers.zh_summary: 该论文研究了多模态文档理解中跨粒度任务（文本跨度级和文档级）的相互增强效应。通过构建 Doc-MRE 数据集，比较了单任务、联合训练和条件训练（训练时在一任务提示中包含另一任务的金标）三种模式。结果表明，在共享配置下，联合训练无法在所有三个语料库上增强；而条件训练在 CORD 和表格语料库上增强效果显著，但在 WildReceipt 上存在权衡。对照实验揭示格式和内容对条件训练效果的影响。
papers.novelty: 发现现有联合训练假设的不足，提出条件训练作为替代，并通过受控实验系统分析跨粒度任务的相互增强效应。
innovation_points: 构建 Doc-MRE 数据集，配对字段级和文档级标注
对比单任务、联合和条件训练，揭示联合训练的局限性
设计双字节相同提示的对照实验，分离格式和内容影响
papers.limitations: 语料库覆盖窄（小票和表格）且规模有限，需在更多类型文档上验证；实验条件固定，未探索更优配置。
improvement_directions: 扩展至更多文档类型和语言，检验 MRE 效应的一般性
研究如何调整训练比例和词汇以提升条件训练效果
探索更细粒度的跨粒度交互方式，以避免权衡
papers.engineering_value: 为多任务文档理解模型的设计提供实证指导，有助于提升工作流效率。
papers.why_relevant: 挑战了常见的多任务联合训练假设，为 OCR 系统中的任务整合方式提供新视角。

papers.title: LatentPress: Context Compression Beyond Text and Vision
papers.summary: Compressed context is usually carried as human-readable text or as rendered images that must be decoded, even when its consumer is a language model. We introduce LatentPress, which writes conversational histories and long documents into a third representation: continuous memory tokens that a frozen decoder reads directly through its input-embedding interface, with no text reconstruction at inference. A small reader-matched writer compresses $4$-$16\times$ while training only an adapter (4.2M-26.2M parameters, $\sim\!0.1\%$ of the decoder). On LongMemEval, LatentPress reaches $0.504$ accuracy at $7.70\times$ compression versus $0.490$ for uncompressed evidence, outperforming text summaries (0.184) and OCR-based compression (0.426 to 0.312). On LongBench-QA, in-domain writers match or exceed raw-context reading at $4$-$8\times$ compression, while $16\times$ trails raw. Writing takes 43ms per conversation, roughly an order of magnitude faster than text summarization or OCR reconstruction, and reading is $5$-$9\times$ faster than raw context or cached OCR. We validate the interface under two transfer settings, zero-shot from UltraChat to LongMemEval memory QA and from LongMemEval-derived QA to unseen LongBench document domains, establishing direct soft tokens as a practical machine-facing context interface beyond text and vision. The implementation of the experiments could be found at: https://github.com/xuyd16ai/context_softtoken_compress .
papers.zh_summary: LatentPress 提出一种新的上下文压缩方法，利用连续记忆 token 将对话历史或长文档压缩为模型可读的机器可面向的表示，无需在推理时重建文本或图像。通过一个小的读取器匹配写入器，训练适配器（参数仅约解码器的 0.1%）实现 4-16 倍压缩。在 LongMemEval 和 LongBench-QA 上，性能优于文本摘要和基于 OCR 的压缩，且写入速度比文本摘要快一个数量级，读取速度快了 5-9 倍。
papers.novelty: 首次提出直接软 token 作为第三方上下文接口，超越文本和视觉表示，机器可读且高效。
innovation_points: 使用连续记忆 token 作为压缩表示，无文本重建
轻量适配器实现高效压缩，读写速度显著优于传统方法
验证迁移设置（零样本和跨域）下的有效性
papers.limitations: 压缩率极高时（如 16 倍）性能下降；依赖预定义写作器，可能不适用于所有任务类型。
improvement_directions: 优化高压缩率下的性能，研究更好的训练策略
扩展至更多场景，如多模态文档压缩
探索适配器与解码器更紧密的耦合，提升通用性
papers.engineering_value: 提供高效的上下文压缩方案，可显著降低长文档处理中的计算和存储成本。
papers.why_relevant: 展示软 token 作为压缩表示的可能性，与 OCR 结合可提供新的上下文处理途径。

papers.title: OCR-Based Field Extraction for Archaeological Pottery Metadata: The CENTURIA Dataset
papers.summary: Pottery is a primary source for reconstructing the chronological and economic dimensions of past societies. Archaeologists often document ceramic finds through technical drawings and handwritten metadata. This metadata is critical for dating, provenance attribution, and cross-site comparison, but remains inaccessible to computational analysis, requiring manual transcription of every record. We investigate whether state-of-the-art document analysis models can address this task, and introduce CENTURIA, a dataset of 507 pottery records from the Roman site of Carnuntum, providing transcriptions, bounding boxes, and structured field-level labels across seven metadata categories. Benchmarking five OCR models reveals a substantial domain gap: zero-shot transcription error reaches 15-32% SpACER-M, far exceeding rates on printed archival documents, with domain-specific fields recovered in fewer than 3% of cases. LoRA fine-tuning on just 57 samples, reflecting a realistic archival annotation budget, closes this gap, reducing transcription error to below 1.5% and recovering overall field-level accuracy above 87%. Our results show that a small expert-validated fine-tuning set suffices to convert handwritten pottery documentation into structured, searchable metadata ready for archaeological databases.
papers.zh_summary: 针对考古陶器手写元数据难以自动化处理的问题，该研究引入了包含507条记录、七类结构化字段标注的CENTURIA数据集。对五种OCR模型的基准测试显示，零样本转录误差达15-32%，领域特定字段恢复率不足3%。“在57个样本上进行LoRA微调后，转录误差降至1.5%以下，整体字段级准确率超过87%，表明小规模专家验证数据微调即可将手写陶器文档结构化，便于考古数据库使用。”
papers.novelty: 首次为考古陶器手写文档创建结构化字段级标注数据集，并验证低资源微调在领域领域应用中的有效性。
innovation_points: 构建考古陶器手写文档的专用数据集并标注字段级语义标签
系统评估通用OCR模型在该领域的显著性能差距
验证少量样本LoRA微调可大幅提升领域适应能力
papers.limitations: ['仅聚焦单一考古遗址数据，未涵盖不同书写风格与更多陶器类型', '字段类别数量有限，可能影响模型泛化能力']
improvement_directions: 扩充数据规模与地域多样性，提高模型对多样风格的稳健性
引入更细粒度字段及实体识别的联合建模
papers.engineering_value: 为博物馆或考古机构提供将手写记录自动数字化、结构化的低成本方案，可直接对接现有档案数据库流程。
papers.why_relevant: 对于OCR领域里特定历史文献类型研究具有代表价值，其聚焦低资源情景与领域迁移，契合许多实际文档解析应用需求。

papers.title: Improving Information Extraction with Learned Queries
papers.summary: When information extraction fails, a natural instinct is to improve the model doing it: for example, by scaling it up or refining its reasoning. In this paper, we show that another part of the pipeline matters at least as much: the queries used to elicit this information. Across four clinical benchmarks and five LLMs, improving the question design alone raises performance by 18.6 F1-score points, i.e. more than using larger extraction models. To make such question design learnable, we introduce List of Questions (LoQ), which generates document-specific question sets, and FeedQ, a feedback-driven optimization method that iteratively refines questions against extraction outcomes. The resulting optimized questions can be used to train lightweight generators: with fine-tuning, 4B-parameter models match or outperform expert-derived baselines and substantially exceed the performance of much larger untuned models. We release a dataset of 12,820 optimized questions to support a broader shift in information extraction research toward treating question design as a first-class problem.
papers.zh_summary: 研究认为除模型本身外，信息抽取所用的查询问题设计也是一个关键管道因素。通过优化问题设计，在四个临床基准与五个大语言模型上，F1分数平均提升18.6点，甚至超过使用更大抽取模型的增益。作者提出List of Questions (LoQ)生成文档特定问题集，及Feedback-Driven Optimization (FeedQ)机制基于抽取结果迭代优化问题，微调内置4B参数模型后性能可与依赖专家且更大的模型媲美。
papers.novelty: 首次系统验证查询设计在信息抽取中的关键作用，并提供可学习的优化框架与数据集。
innovation_points: 提出LoQ方法动态生成文档相关的问题集
设计FeedQ迭代优化反馈机制提升抽取表现
发布包含12,820个优化问题的训练数据集
papers.limitations: ['实验结果主要基于临床领域，需要验证在更多场景的有效性', '问题设计优化可能受限于语言模型自身的理解能力']
improvement_directions: 将问询优化扩展到跨领域更丰富的文档类型
进一步探讨轻量模型上使用生成问题的泛化能力
papers.engineering_value: 提供一种通过外围问题调节提升信息抽取效果的实用路径，支持资源受限环境中根据上下文动态优化抽取条件。
papers.why_relevant: 为信息抽取任务提供全新视角，其问题驱动的思路在知识获取中的可控性能影响抽取质量，对整个文档理解系统具有启示。

papers.title: Can Scene Text Recognition Read Rare Compositions?
papers.summary: Scene text recognition is reported as 89--97% accurate on the six standard benchmarks, and the problem is widely treated as saturated. We present an alternative reading. When the same test images are stratified jointly by ground-truth word rarity and character n-gram novelty against a reference corpus, accuracy at the rare-word x rare-trigram corner of the resulting 5x5 grid drops 10--18 pt below the q3/q3 centre across nine English specialised recognisers, and the same direction (corner below centre) holds on all 13 of 13 (language, model) pairs we test across four writing systems (Latin, Han, Han+kana, Arabic). The drop is not a capacity bottleneck. A 6x vision-backbone scale-up (CLIP4STR-Base 158M -> CLIP4STR-Huge 1.0B, OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 LAION-2B) leads every benchmark in aggregate accuracy yet leaves the stress corner unchanged (86.9 -> 86.5, within paired-bootstrap noise). Four converging probes--layer-wise probing, confidence-when-wrong, attention re-balancing, and a cross-script commit-vs-abstain error split--localise the failure to the autoregressive decoder's lexical prior. We then ask how much of the gap existing techniques recover. Of 16 non-architectural mitigations, the largest mean q5/q5 gain is +1.3 pt and none clears the paired-bootstrap noise floor; the only intervention that does is the architectural shift from autoregressive to CTC decoding (SVTRv2, +2.5 pt, p=0.02, n=474). A confidence-routed AR-CTC ensemble adds a directionally consistent +0.6 pt that stays within noise, and its dominant learned coefficient is each model's own minimum-softmax confidence--independently echoing the mechanism above. No configuration we test improves both the compositional corner and aggregate accuracy. The rare-input long tail thus points to architectural change rather than added capacity.
papers.zh_summary: 针对有人声称场景文字识别（STR）已饱和，该论文采用细化分层方式检视测试图像中文字稀有性与字符n-gram新颖性联合分布的差异。结果在多个模型和语言系统里，罕见字-罕见三字组组合准确率下降10-18点。研究者通过探针定位到自回归解码器导致的词汇先验问题，并发现扩大视觉骨干模型无济于事，而改用CTC解码可以部分改善此差异。
papers.novelty: 挑战场景文字识别基准饱和的观点，揭示性能集中在常用组合而对罕见组合仍存在显著失败空白，并指出关键瓶颈在解码器。
innovation_points: 对标准基准采用精细维度进行分类评估，识别未被发现的系统性失败模式
使用多类型探针定位至词汇先验并验证扩大模型规模无效
试验多种缓解措施并对比AR与CTC架构差异
papers.limitations: ['实验结果依赖固定基准与特定参考语料，可能受其代表性影响', '未提供完全消除此差距的解决方案，仅指出CTC架构更具优势']
improvement_directions: 开发更有效降低解码器词汇偏置的结构化方法
探索将自回归与CTC结合、在推理过程中动态选择解码策略以减少对词汇先验的依赖
papers.engineering_value: 对实际场景中的少见词识别有提示作用，帮助优化理解型文字识别系统的边界，指导构建面向长尾词汇的鲁棒模型。
papers.why_relevant: 直接关注文字识别模型的通用性弱点，为细粒度评估与结构化改进提供新思路，对提升实际可部署系统的可靠性有重要价值。

papers.title: Enoki: Efficient Multi-Level Hallucination Detection
papers.summary: Ensuring factuality remains a critical challenge for deploying LLMs in high-stakes settings. Existing hallucination detectors usually operate at a single level: claim-level methods provide interpretable factual units, while span-level methods localize unsupported text. Bridging these views is costly, as LLM-heavy pipelines require multiple decomposition and verification calls, and modular systems need additional claim-to-span alignment. We propose Enoki, an Open Information Extraction framework for multi-level hallucination detection. Enoki extracts text-anchored relational facts, verifies them against evidence, and projects unsupported facts back to hallucinated spans. This shared representation enables claim-level verification and span-level localization without requiring separate alignment. Enoki supports LLM-based, encoder-based, and rule-based extraction regimes, balancing accuracy and inference cost through a common interface. Experiments show that Enoki remains competitive with strong claim-level systems while using fewer resources and achieves superior performance on fine-grained span- and entity-level localization. We also release EnokiQA, a dual-granularity dataset with aligned claim-level verification and span-level localization annotations.
papers.zh_summary: 针对大语言模型幻觉检测在声明及跨度层面之间存在成本高且系统复杂度大的难题，该研究提出Enoki，一个基于开放信息抽取的多层级幻觉检测框架。通过抽取文本锚定的关系事实并对照证据验证，然后将不支持事实映射回幻觉文本跨度，从而在一个模型内既支持声明级验证，又支持跨度级定位，无需额外对齐过程。同时支持多种抽取法规并发布了细粒度标注的数据集EnokiQA。
papers.novelty: 首次以统一框架同时实现声明级验证和跨度级定位，显著降低传统方法中大量分解对齐计算开销。
innovation_points: 基于开放信息抽取构建多级表征，减少多个LLM调用和额外对齐
提供三种抽取模式以适应不同算力与精度需求
发布包含双重粒度标记的EnokiQA数据集，支持细粒度性能评估
papers.limitations: ['在验证时抽取的事实可能仍依赖于具体证据质量，因此挑战跨语种、复杂上下文表现', '相对其他方案，在边界情况和多义文本处理上还需进一步验证']
improvement_directions: 引入更精细证据检索策略来强化各抽取模式的表现
推广至多语言及跨领域以检验框架的泛化性
papers.engineering_value: 为需要事实溯源的内容验证系统提供可部署框架，以平衡成本和细粒度定位能力。
papers.why_relevant: 有助于文档处理流程的最终输出准确性保证，并提供新的信息抽取视角来支持可靠和可追踪的文本验证。

papers.title: Configurable Semantic Chunking for Biomedical Information Extraction in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.summary: BioMedRAG introduced retrieval-augmented generation with a learned chunk scorer for biomedical information extraction. However, it relies on fixed-size chunking which can fragment semantic evidence. We propose a configurable semantic chunking framework that addresses this limitation by combining entity-preserving windows, trigger-centered chunking, proposition-first extraction, tiered trigger prioritization, and hierarchical relation resolution. The framework integrates with BioMedRAG by replacing only the chunk construction stage while preserving the embedding model, learned chunk scorer, generator, and evaluation protocol. We evaluate the framework on biomedical relation extraction benchmarks (GM-CIHT, DDI, ChemProt) and adverse event classification (ADE). On GM-CIHT, the full hybrid configuration achieves 82.6% F1, improving over the fixed-size baseline (74.2% F1) by 8.4 points under our experimental setup. Cross-dataset analysis shows that semantic chunking improves extraction datasets with explicit relation cues, such as GM-CIHT and DDI, while fixed chunking remains competitive or stronger for dense biochemical extraction and binary classification settings such as ChemProt and ADE. By externalizing chunking logic into configuration files, the framework provides an interpretable and adaptable alternative to rigid fixed-size chunking for biomedical RAG pipelines.
papers.zh_summary: 针对BioMedRAG在生物医学信息抽取中固定窗口分块导致的证据碎片化问题，提出可配置语义分块框架，通过实体保持窗口、触发词中心分块、命题优先提取、分层触发词优先级及层级关系解析等多策略组合。在GM-CIHT等基准上验证框架可分性；与BioMedRAG固定窗口基线相比，在GM-CIHT上F1提升8.4点，但DDI等有显式关系提示的数据集获益明显，在ChemProt等密集生物化学抽取场景固定分块仍具竞争力。
papers.novelty: 将分块策略从固定大小转向外部配置化的语义结构，并保留原系统其余组件不变进行模块化升级。
innovation_points: 提出多种可组合的语义分块策略并支持配置化外部控制
在多个生物医学基准任务系统评测并与原BioMedRAG作公平对比
强调基于任务特征动态选择分块类型的思想
papers.limitations: ['实验结果显示出任务相关的选择性优势，不能广泛适用于所有抽取场景', '需要针对性配置，不同数据集可能需人工调参']
improvement_directions: 探索自动化配置选择模块，根据任务特性动态选择或组合语义分块策略
尝试集成上下文特异性特征以进一步改善长尾与复杂关系抽取
papers.engineering_value: 提供一种模块化改造思路，可快速集成到已有RAG流程中，尤其适合建模需要语义支持而非简单窗口切分的知识抽取系统。
papers.why_relevant: 对信息抽取尤为重要的分块环节提供新启发，能提升RAG在医学这类高度依赖上下文抽取的数据上的表现。

papers.title: TWIX: a Two-Stage Approach for End-To-End Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction
papers.summary: The exponential growth of scientific publications calls for automatic Information Extraction (IE) systems to support knowledge discovery. In this context, the GutBrainIE benchmark evaluates Named Entity Recognition (NER), Named Entity Recognition and Disambiguation (NERD), and Relation Extraction (RE) systems in the gut-brain axis domain. We propose Two-stage Workflow for Information eXtraction (TWIX), an end-to-end IE pipeline featuring three interconnected modules, each leveraging a two-stage framework to solve all four GutBrainIE subtasks. Evaluation on the development and test sets shows that our method substantially outperforms the baseline by a wide margin, while also ranking first among all participant submissions across all subtasks. These results indicate that the proposed two-stage pipeline effectively improves both precision and recall in practical settings.
papers.zh_summary: 为应对科学文献激增并对IE系统的需求，该工作提出TWIX，一种将命名实体识别、消歧与关系抽取集成到端到端流水线的两阶段方案。围绕GutBrainIE基准的四个子任务构建三个连接模块，以两级处理来增强精确率和召回率。在开发和测试集上的评估显示其相对基线性能大幅领先，并在所有子任务上排名第一。
papers.novelty: 为肠脑轴领域提供一种端到端但内部利用两级框架的NLP流水线，兼具模块化与效果优势。
innovation_points: 设计统一而结构化的两阶段处理流程支持NER、消歧及关系抽取多种任务协同
将任务解耦以在两个层面针对性优化特征提取和分类头
在公共基准上展示超越所有参赛方案的较优结果
papers.limitations: ['当前验证主要局限于单一领域基准的评估', '未充分讨论在资源泛化时的可扩展性']
improvement_directions: 将方法迁移至其他学科以检验任务通用性
尝试精简任务解耦方式以减少潜在误差传播，保持整体精度
papers.engineering_value: 可适配于处理科学文献关键信息发现，降低人工筛选成本，为文献挖掘和数据库整理提供稳健处理步骤。
papers.why_relevant: 展示在实际生物医学信息抽取挑战设定下解决NER与RE综合问题的高性能路径，对提高自动文档解析系统的精度有参考价值。
